Chapter 96: Intermittent Spiritual Emptiness (Bonus Chapter for Alliance Head Aiai Fengzhong Yufan)

In the blink of an eye, it was the final stage of course selection.

Senior Li Hang from the Yuanhuo Club had also started drawing the original art for *Legends of the Three Kingdoms*.

"Chen Guiliang, have you finished choosing?" Jiang Junlai came over to ask.

Chen Guiliang said, "Pretty much done."

"Let me see." Jiang Junlai himself was clueless. He had selected many science courses but also found the liberal arts courses interesting.

Chen Guiliang's schedule was as follows:

Required courses exclusive to the Yuanpei Program: *History of Chinese Civilization*, *Western Civilization from a Global Perspective*, *Scientific Methodology*, *Critical Writing and Academic Integrity*.

University-wide required courses: *College English*, *Physical Education*, *Political Theory*, *Military Theory* (online course).

General education electives: *Ancient Chinese Literature*, *Introduction to Logic*, *Principles of Economics*, *Introduction to Sociology*, *Basic Physics Experiments*, *Introduction to Astronomy*.

For the new students in the Yuanpei Program this year, *Advanced Math* was surprisingly not a required course but had become a general education elective.

Chen Guiliang had chosen a very standard 14 courses.

Choosing more than 18 courses was considered super aggressive, which would result in an overflow of credits.

Choosing fewer than 10 would make it difficult to meet the credit requirements, and academic advisors would generally not approve.

Courses like *Introduction to Astronomy* were purely for getting easy credits; you could go stargazing at night, and there wasn't even a final exam. Of course, it awarded very few credits.

After looking at Chen Guiliang's schedule, Jiang Junlai struggled for a while before gritting his teeth and finalizing his own courses.

Chen Guiliang counted them and felt that this kid had gone mad.

Twenty courses, studying both liberal arts and sciences!

"Are you planning to learn from Guo Feng?" Chen Guiliang couldn't help but laugh.

Jiang Junlai said, "I want to learn everything. Anyway, there's a two-week trial period. If I really don't have the energy, I can just drop the extra courses."

"That's true," Chen Guiliang nodded.

Jiang Junlai said mysteriously, "Do you remember that guy Zeng Changgao, who came to our dorm to play cards last time?"

"I remember, the science studies committee member," Chen Guiliang said.

Jiang Junlai said, "Zeng Changgao's memory is freakishly good. A couple of days ago, a few of us were chatting, and he was sitting nearby, flipping through a book, turning a page every minute or so. By the time we finished chatting, he had finished the whole book. I thought he was just flipping through it out of boredom, but it turned out he could describe the general content of the book! Not just a vague summary, but he could even recall important details from it."

"That's pretty damn amazing," Chen Guiliang said with sincere admiration.

Jiang Junlai said, "I can't let him beat me. I heard he also signed up for 20 courses!"

The two of them went to the South Gate, each spending a few dozen yuan on a second-hand bicycle.

Then they rushed off to get their course selections approved by their advisors.

Chen Guiliang's advisor was Lai Liangcai, a sociology professor.

The student counselor was confirmed to be a third-year student named Long Xiang. This was very strange, as Senior Long was clearly a science major, yet he was assigned to a group of liberal arts students.

Jiang Junlai, a new science major, had his counselor changed to a third-year female senior from the social sciences.

After finalizing his courses, Chen Guiliang slung his backpack on and went to the main library.

Using the index for the *Veritable Records of the Ming Dynasty*, he found the volumes he needed, took out a pen and paper, and selectively transcribed interesting content.

There was far too much material, so Chen Guiliang just scanned through it, looking for what he needed.

Time passed without him noticing. When Chen Guiliang felt his stomach rumbling, he looked at the time and saw it was already 7:30 PM.

He went to grab a bowl of noodles, then rode his bike back to the dorm.

Only Guo Feng was in dorm 404. This living legend was watching *The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber*.

"Lao Guo, how many courses did you sign up for when you first started as a freshman?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Guo Feng, his eyes fixed on the computer screen, said, "22."

Chen Guiliang was speechless.

Guo Feng continued, "I was reckless back then and even failed one course. I later cut it down to 20."

"How is it now?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Guo Feng said, "It's painful. My major is biology, but I don't like it very much."

"You can change your major," Chen Guiliang said.

Guo Feng said, "Too lazy to change, and I don't know what I'd change to. I'll just muddle through until I graduate in my fourth year and find any random job."

"You should be able to finish all your credits by your third year, right?" Chen Guiliang said.

Guo Feng said, "My family's financial situation is decent, both my parents are civil servants, so they don't need me to earn money to support them. I might as well muddle through an extra year in university. Graduating in the third year would be so boring."

You call taking 20 courses "muddling through"?

Guo Feng paused the video. "Do you have a girlfriend?"

"What's up?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Guo Feng found it hard to say. "I'm perfectly fine talking to guys, quite confident, in fact. But when I talk to girls, I get a bit... well, insecure. No, that's not right. I only become insecure when I meet a girl I like. Can you teach me how to pursue a girl? Especially when facing a girl you admire, how can you boost your confidence?"

Chen Guiliang thought for a moment. "Disenchantment."

"Huh?" Guo Feng didn't understand.

Chen Guiliang said, "Don't imagine that girl to be too perfect. She also shits and farts, and she also wants to find a boyfriend. And you're also outstanding, a perfect match for her."

Guo Feng understood but didn't agree. "If I disenchant myself from the girl I admire, why would I still like her? Why would I still pursue her? She must be sacred and perfect to be worthy of my affection and pursuit."

Chen Guiliang said, "Lao Guo, I'm trying to tell you how to pursue a girl, and you're discussing the philosophy of love with me. If we keep talking like this, I don't think we'll get anywhere."

"You're right," Guo Feng nodded.

Chen Guiliang asked, "Do you think a sacred and perfect woman truly exists in this world?"

Guo Feng thought of the girl he had a secret crush on and said with a firm tone, "She must exist. We have one right here at Peking University."

"Which department is she in?" Chen Guiliang asked curiously.

Guo Feng said, "A senior in the biology department, she's already been accepted into the graduate program. I chose biology as my major because of her. She looks so beautiful when she's doing experiments—quiet, focused, like a black hole that can suck in all the light in the world."

Chen Guiliang thought to himself: This guy is a lost cause.

"How about I help you write a love poem?" Chen Guiliang asked.

Guo Feng shook his head repeatedly. "If I'm going to write one, I'll write it myself. Getting someone to ghostwrite is a form of deception. How could I deceive her? That would be a blasphemy against love."

Chen Guiliang started to try and persuade him. "If you want her to like you, you have to have a shining quality, right? Otherwise, why should she even give you a second look?"

"Right," Guo Feng agreed.

Chen Guiliang asked, "What's your shining quality?"

Guo Feng thought long and hard. "I don't seem to have one. I deliberately chose a random assortment of courses, especially ones that are completely unrelated, just to attract her attention. But she didn't notice me. Instead, I got the nickname 'Crazy Guo'."

"You have to achieve something in some field!" Chen Guiliang continued his persuasion.

Guo Feng said, "Apart from being decent at studying, I don't have any other skills. But there are too many people at Peking University who are good at studying. I can't stand out at all."

Chen Guiliang asked, "How are your computer skills?"

"They're okay. I started learning in my freshman year." As long as they weren't talking about love, Guo Feng was quite confident in himself.

Chen Guiliang said, "Start a website with me. Once you've built a career, you'll be a successful person. Don't you think she'll see you in a different light then?"

Guo Feng said, "She's not that shallow."

Chen Guiliang was about to be defeated.

This lunatic!

"What if she does like successful people? How will you know if you don't try?" Chen Guiliang said.

Guo Feng said, "If she likes someone because they're rich, it would only lower my opinion of her. She would no longer be perfect and not worthy of my affection."

Damn it, we're back to where we started.

Chen Guiliang couldn't help but retort, "Senior, I think you're suited for deep philosophical research."

Guo Feng said, "I've taken philosophy classes before. I didn't like them much, so I dropped them after getting a few credits. Forget it. It seems you don't understand either. I'll just keep watching *The Heaven Sword and Dragon Saber*."

Chen Guiliang asked, "Doesn't Zhao Min use any means necessary to pursue Zhang Wuji?"

Guo Feng shot back, "I can tell the difference between a TV show and reality. Don't use fictional characters to make analogies."
